questions.question: The radius of a hemisphere is 5 cm. Find the volume.
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Volume of a hemisphere = (2/3) × π × r³

Given: r = 5 cm

Volume = (2/3) × (22/7) × 5 × 5 × 5

Volume = (2 × 22 × 125) ÷ 21 ≈ 261.9 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 261.9 cm³.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Radius of the hemisphere (r) = 5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of Hemisphere (V) = (2/3) × πr³

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/72817f2f2c94fe01c064d543a2cb7d59b3ba4554bb4a97f60ce1d69f7eeed994.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Volume = (2/3) × (22/7) × (5)³

⇒ Volume = (2/3) × (22/7) × 125

⇒ Volume = (44 × 125) ÷ 21

⇒ Volume = 5500 ÷ 21

⇒ Volume ≈ 261.9047 cm³

**∴ The correct answer is 261.9 cm³.**

**__Additional Information__**

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of Hemisphere

The surface area of the curved part is 2πr².

Total Surface Area (TSA) of Hemisphere

Includes the base circle area: TSA = 2πr² + πr² = 3πr².

Volume of a Full Sphere

The volume of a complete sphere is exactly double that of a hemisphere: V = (4/3)πr³.</p

questions.question: Among four students sitting in a row, average age of last three students is 48 years and the average age of first three students is 50 years. If the age of first student is 56 years, then what is the age of the last student?
questions.solution:
Given:

The total students are = 4

The average age of first three students = 50 years

The average age of last three students = 48 years

The age of first student = 56 years

Concept:

Average ={The sum of all itemsover The total number of items}

Calculation:

Let all student = x, y, z, p

According to the question

The sum of the age of the first three students

x + y + z = 3 × 50 = 150 years..........(1)

The sum of the age of the last three students

y + z + p = 3 × 48 = 144 years....(2)

Subtract 1 from 2.

x - p = 6

As age of x = 56

p = 56 - 6 = 50

∴ The required result will be 50 years.

B can complete the work in = 33.33% less time then A

X\% ={Xover 100} 

**Formula used:**

Work = Efficiency × Time

**Calculation:**

Let B can complete the work in X days

Time taken by B to complete the work = {(1- {1over3})}times 60 = {2over3}times 60 =40 days

questions.question: If the heights of two cylinders are in the ratio of 7 ∶ 9 and their diameters are in the ratio of 6 ∶ 7, then what is the ratio of the volumes of the cylinders?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The height of the two cylinder are ratio = 7 : 9

The diameter of the cylinder are in ratio = 6 : 7

**Formula used:**

The volume of the cylinder = π × r² × h Where, r = The radius of the cylinder, and h = The height of the cylinder

**Calculation:**

Let the radius of the cylinders be 7x and 9x and diameter of the cylinder 6y and 7y respectively

The volume of the first cylinder = π × 7x × (6y/2)²

The volume of the second cylinder = π × 9x × (7y/2)²

The ratio of the volume of the cylinders ={pi times 7x times 36y²over pi times 9x times 49y²} = {7 times 36over 9 times 49} = {4over 7}

**∴ The required result will be 4 : 7.**

questions.question: A person covers first 15 km in 60 minutes and next 24 km in 30 minutes. What is his average speed for the whole Journey?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Average Speed = Total Distance ÷ Total Time

Total Distance = 15 + 24 = 39 km

Total Time = 60 + 30 = 90 minutes = 1.5 hours

Average Speed = 39 ÷ 1.5 = 26 km/hr

**∴ The correct answer is 26 km/hr.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Distance₁ = 15 km, Time₁ = 60 minutes

Distance₂ = 24 km, Time₂ = 30 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Average Speed = (Total Distance Covered) ÷ (Total Time Taken)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Total Distance = 15 + 24 = 39 km

⇒ Total Time = 60 + 30 = 90 minutes

⇒ Total Time in hours = 90 ÷ 60 = 1.5 hours

⇒ Average Speed = 39 ÷ 1.5

⇒ Average Speed = 390 ÷ 15

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Average Speed for Equal Distances

If a person covers two equal distances at speeds x and y, then the average speed is 2xy ÷ (x + y).

Average Speed for Equal Time Intervals

If a person travels at speeds x and y for equal time intervals, the average speed is (x + y) ÷ 2.

Unit Conversion

To convert km/hr to m/s, multiply the speed by 5 ÷ 18. To convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.</p

questions.question: A man goes from A to B at a speed of 200 kmph and comes back to A at a speed of 300 kmph. Find his average speed for the entire journey?
If A is 20 percent less than B, then B is how much percentage more than A?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A is 20% less than B

**Concept:**

X\%={Xover100}

**Calculation:**

Let the B is X

According to the question

The A = {(1 - {20over 100})}times X= {4over5}times X= {4Xover5}

How much percentage more than A is B

⇒ {(X-{4Xover5})over {4Xover5}} times 100={Xover4}times 100=25\%

**∴ The required result will be 25%.**

questions.question: Marked price of a toy is 100 rupees and the selling price is 80 rupees. Calculate the discount percentage.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The marked price of the toy = 100

The selling price of the toy = 80

**Concept:**

Discount = Marked price - Selling price

**Formula used:**

{D\%}={MP-SPover MP} times 100 Where, D = Discount, MP = marked price, and SP = Selling price

**Calculation:**

Let the discount percentage be X

According to the question

Discount = 100 - 80 = 20

Discount percentage = X= {20over100}times 100= 20\%

**∴ The required result will be 20%.**

questions.question: Pankaj sells an article and earns a profit of 55 percent. What will be the ratio of cost price and selling price?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The profit percentage is 55 percentage.

**Concept:**

Profit = Selling price - Cost price

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be C and selling price be S

According to the question

⇒ 55={S-Cover C}times 100

⇒ 11={S-Cover C}times 20

⇒ 11C = 20S - 20C

⇒ 11C + 20C = 20S

⇒ 31C = 20S

⇒ {Cover S}={20over31}

**∴ The required result will be 20 : 31.**
